description: Durable state ledger for semantic sentence-veto research lanes. This prevents recorded ideas, partial harness support, completed sweeps, and promotion claims from being collapsed into one ambiguous done state.

state_definitions.idea_recorded: The idea is documented but no dedicated harness support or sweep exists.
state_definitions.queued_next: The idea is selected for near-term implementation or sweep work.
state_definitions.harness_partial: Some reusable machinery exists, but the lane has not been fully represented as a fair bakeoff.
state_definitions.harness_ready_unswept: The harness can express the lane, but the full frozen plus held-out sweep has not been run.
state_definitions.swept_inconclusive: A sweep ran and produced useful evidence, but no promotable candidate emerged.
state_definitions.swept_negative: A sweep ran and argued against the tested form of the idea.
state_definitions.swept_promising_control: A sweep produced the current best control or a promising non-production candidate.
state_definitions.active_source_program: The lane is being advanced in source-admission or breadth-validation artifacts rather than this decision matrix alone.
state_definitions.parked_second_lane: The lane remains intentionally parked until cheaper controls identify the exact comparison worth the cost.

methodology_rules: Do not use a generic done state.
Do not mark a lane swept without a reproducible manifest or generated artifact.
Do not mark a lane promotable from discovery data alone.
Do not collapse source-coverage work, score-surface work, final decision-rule work, and phrase/no-winner work into one metric.
Keep negative controls visible for every candidate family.
Keep phrase/no-winner behavior visible separately from active-vs-shadow scoring.
Record whether the lane changes c, a, similarity, aggregation, final decision, source coverage, phrase handling, or runtime policy.
Production runtime policy remains unchanged until a candidate beats the incumbent on frozen and held-out suites.

lanes.current_read: Margin, ratio, softmax, and pairwise variants often tie on final YES/NO decisions under the fixed source surface. No final decision family is promotable yet.
lanes.next_action: Keep as the promotion gate after stronger c/a/source candidates emerge.

lanes.current_read: Separate evidence rows with max row or top-k aggregation are the current best no-spend control: 0 harmful replacements and 45 false abstains.
lanes.next_action: Use as incumbent for the next context-conditioned and sentence-transformer row-level sweeps.

lanes.current_read: Synthetic order/frame labels over existing gloss evidence did not beat row-level evidence. Best phrase/frame rows stayed safe but over-abstained.
lanes.next_action: Retest phrasing with real source/example rows and context-conditioned evidence selection rather than declaring order/frame irrelevant.

lanes.current_read: The dedicated sentence-transformer row-level bakeoff is now swept across frozen v10, source-heldout v2, phrase-heldout v2, and phrase challenge. The best additive-source top-k row tied the sentence-transformer definition/example control at 1 harmful / 31 false abstains, while all five negative controls failed as expected. The scorer has useful rank signal, but this row-level form is not promotable because it does not clear zero harm or beat the no-source sentence-transformer control.
lanes.next_action: Do not promote this scorer swap. Keep the artifact as a diagnostic comparison, and only revisit sentence-transformer row-level scoring with a richer guard stack, source-family agreement, or case-level calibration after the TF-IDF additive/source-coverage path has a stronger zero-harm candidate.

lanes.current_read: The first context-conditioned sweep loaded 87 admitted source rows and did not beat the separate-row max control: best source-plus-definition selectors over-abstained at 53 false abstains and pure source-row selectors at 55. After live aligned-frame generation plus strict admission, the v2 selector-ready composite has 126 rows and all 19 active/shadow families are selector-ready. The best source-plus-definition selector improved to 0 harmful / 47 false abstains, while pure source-row selectors are 0 / 48. A later source-scope bakeoff showed the stronger current surface is additive source evidence over the row-level control, not context selection by itself.
lanes.next_action: Keep the selector machinery as research infrastructure, but do not promote it. Re-test context selection only after additive source evidence, source-family agreement, or calibrated row aggregation has a stronger row surface to select from.

lanes.current_read: Per-row source evidence scopes now let the matrix compare no-source, LLM-v2 source, WordNet-reference source, and combined-source rows in one artifact. The additive `definition_example_plus_source_rows_separate` surface with combined LLM-v2 plus WordNet-reference rows is the current best no-spend research candidate: 0 harmful / 37 false abstains across frozen v10, source-heldout v2, phrase-heldout v2, and phrase challenge. The no-source row control was 0 / 44; source-heldout v2 improved from 0 / 17 to 0 / 12. The cell trace shows this is source representation progress: LLM-v2 lacked red-blood-cell active evidence, while the existing WordNet-reference lane supplied it.
lanes.next_action: Do not change production policy yet. Run companion negative controls and broader held-out validation for the additive surface, then test source-family agreement, calibrated row weighting, and additive context-selected variants against this candidate.

lanes.current_read: Individual context views have been tested, but no composed multi-context score surface has been fairly swept.
lanes.next_action: After context-conditioned evidence selection, add multi-context rows that combine masked sentence, raw window, before/after frame, and phrase-risk views.

lanes.current_read: Source-weighted top-k and source dropout exist, but agreement-count and minimum independent source-family agreement have not been implemented as first-class bakeoff rows.
lanes.next_action: Implement source-family agreement aggregators only after the evidence rows carry reliable source-family labels.

lanes.current_read: The source-row loader and context selector exist, and the source-frame gap plan has now been executed under spend caps. The first live aligned-frame run generated 97 rows; strict leakage/duplicate and sense admission kept 36. Merged into the prior 87-row source control, the frozen source-admission ablation improved to 0 harmful / 1 false abstain, but active/shadow held-out v2 still had 1 false abstain. A prompt-process fix added aligned-sentence-frame-v2 diversity frames; the follow-up 5-row board-shadow micro-run admitted 3 rows and made all 19 active/shadow families selector-ready. The source-scope margin bakeoff then showed a stronger way to use source rows: add them to the incumbent definition/example row surface. Combined LLM-v2 plus WordNet-reference additive rows reached 0 harmful / 37 false abstains across four suites, versus 0 / 44 for the no-source row control.
lanes.next_action: Do not promote yet. Treat additive source evidence as the leading research candidate and test companion negative controls, broader heldout, source-family agreement, calibrated aggregation, and additive context selection before a runtime-policy claim.

lanes.current_read: Automatic non-v10 source-supported waves are promising but still need broader held-out proof and phrase-contract coverage before runtime-quality claims. The wave64 any-POS supported sweep found a 16-family semantic source portfolio, and the materialized portfolio passes the source-admission cycle with 51 final admitted rows, 0 leakage rejects, 0 sense rejects, and semantic contract coverage 16 / 16. The first independent held-out suites block promotion: active/shadow is 2 harmful / 3 false abstains across 32 cases, and phrase/no-winner is 3 harmful across 16 cases. A no-write margin sensitivity check showed this is not a simple threshold issue.
lanes.next_action: Classify and fix reusable blocker classes before breadth expansion: source-evidence gaps for active false abstains, surface/POS or sense-family errors for active/shadow harmful replacements, and phrase/no-winner containment for fast/present/end-style failures. Do not tune directly on these held-out cases or claim promotion from this portfolio yet.

lanes.current_read: Documented as a possible second-lane scorer, but not worth implementing until row-level and context-conditioned controls identify the target failure class.
lanes.next_action: Revisit only if no-spend and sentence-transformer row-level sweeps leave a specific same-POS ambiguity unresolved.

lanes.next_action: Revisit after row-level evidence reveals failures that look like semantic adjacency rather than source sparsity.
